Message.Name: Enter Order Message
Message.Description: Enters a new order into Nasdaq Nordic

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: Sequence number, unique and strictly increasing for the day

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of order being entered

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Within Firm
Field.Description: Short code for the execution decision maker

Field.Name: Investment Decision Within Firm
Field.Description: Short code for the investment decision maker

Field.Name: Client Identifier
Field.Description: Short code representing the client behind the order

Field.Name: Party Role Qualifier
Field.Description: Qualifies the client, investment and execution short codes

Field.Name: Algo Indicator
Field.Description: Whether the order resulted from algorithmic trading

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: Remaining length of the TagValue element

Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: Alters attributes of a live order in a single message

Field.Name: OrigUserRefNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the order being replaced

Field.Name: NewUserRefNum
Field.Description: New sequence number for the replacement

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: Remaining length of the TagValue element

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: Requests that an order be cancelled or reduced

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the order being cancelled

Message.Name: Account Query Message
Message.Description: Requests the next available UserRefNum when recovering state

Message.Name: MMI Notification Request Message
Message.Description: Requests a market making instruction notification

Field.Name: Add or Remove
Field.Description: Whether the instruction is added or removed

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Signals an event affecting the entire Nasdaq Nordic system

Message.Name: Order Accepted Message
Message.Description: Acknowledges receipt and acceptance of a valid Enter Order

Field.Name: Execution Within Firm
Field.Description: Short code for the execution decision maker

Field.Name: Investment Decision Within Firm
Field.Description: Short code for the investment decision maker

Field.Name: Client Identifier
Field.Description: Short code representing the client behind the order

Field.Name: Party Role Qualifier
Field.Description: Qualifies the client, investment and execution short codes

Field.Name: Algo Indicator
Field.Description: Whether the order resulted from algorithmic trading

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: Remaining length of the TagValue element

Message.Name: Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: Confirms that an order has been replaced

Field.Name: OrigUserRefNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the replaced order

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: Remaining length of the TagValue element

Message.Name: Cancelled Order Message
Message.Description: An order has been reduced or cancelled

Field.Name: Decrement Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity just decremented from the order

Field.Name: Cancel Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or cancelled

Message.Name: Cancel Pending Message
Message.Description: A cancel request cannot be applied immediately

Message.Name: Replace Pending Message
Message.Description: A replace request cannot be applied immediately

Field.Name: OrigUserRefNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the order being replaced

Message.Name: Executed Order Message
Message.Description: An order has been executed in whole or in part

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Execution time in nanoseconds past midnight

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the executed order

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which the shares executed

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: An execution has been broken and cannot be reinstated

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Match number of the broken execution

Field.Name: Broken Trade Reason
Field.Description: The reason the trade was broken

Message.Name: Rejected Order Message
Message.Description: An order has been rejected

Field.Name: Rejected Order Reason
Field.Description: The reason the order was rejected

Message.Name: Cancel Rejected Message
Message.Description: A cancel request has been rejected

Field.Name: Cancel Rejected Reason
Field.Description: The reason the cancel was rejected

Message.Name: Order Restated Message
Message.Description: An order has been restated by the system

Field.Name: Restate Reason
Field.Description: The reason for this order being restated

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: Remaining length of the TagValue element

Message.Name: MMO Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Requests a market maker order refresh

Field.Name: Firm
Field.Description: Firm the request is directed to

Message.Name: Account Query Response Message
Message.Description: Indicates the next available UserRefNum

Message.Name: GTC Cancelled Message
Message.Description: A Gtc order could not be restated in the morning

Field.Name: Original Order Entry Date
Field.Description: Original order entry date for a cancelled Gtc order

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number
Field.Description: Original order reference number for a cancelled Gtc order

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: The reason the Gtc order was cancelled

Message.Name: Response to MMI Notification Message
Message.Description: Response to a market making instruction notification

Field.Name: Add or Remove
Field.Description: Whether the instruction is added or removed

Field.Name: Instruction Status
Field.Description: Whether the instruction was accepted or rejected

Message.Name: Pending Order Message
Message.Description: An order is pending while the system processes it

Message.Name: Stream Status Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an indication of interest changes its streaming

Field.Name: CumRate
Field.Description: Current cumulative streaming Ltr the order is achieving

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Whether the stream is on or off

Field.Name: Clearing Account Value
Field.Description: Supplemental accounting information forwarded to the Ccp

Field.Name: Clearing Account Type Value
Field.Description: Account type used for the order when submitted to clearing

Field.Name: Clearing Firm Value
Field.Description: User supplied clearing firm, pass through field

Field.Name: Client Reference Value
Field.Description: User supplied client reference, returned unchanged

Field.Name: Cross Type Value

Field.Name: DEA Indicator Value
Field.Description: Origin of the order for direct electronic access reporting

Field.Name: Expire Time Value
Field.Description: Seconds the order should live before being cancelled

Field.Name: Firm Value
Field.Description: The accepted firm for the order

Field.Name: Liquidity Provision Indicator Value
Field.Description: Whether the order relates to liquidity provision activity

Field.Name: Max Floor Value
Field.Description: Displayed quantity for an iceberg order

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity Value
Field.Description: Minimum quantity that could be traded

Field.Name: Order Reference Value
Field.Description: User supplied order reference, returned unchanged

Field.Name: Original Order Entry Date Value
Field.Description: Original order entry date for a good till cancel order

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number Value
Field.Description: Original order reference number for a good till cancel order

Field.Name: Peg Difference Value
Field.Description: Ticks to offset the price from the peg target

Field.Name: Peg Type Value
Field.Description: The peg target, valid for any peggable order

Field.Name: Random Reserve Value
Field.Description: Range the display size is randomized by on refresh

Field.Name: Secondary Order Reference Number Value
Field.Description: Alternative order reference used on the market data feeds

Field.Name: STP Action Value
Field.Description: Action taken when self trade prevention triggers

Field.Name: STP Level Value
Field.Description: Scope of self trade prevention for the order

Field.Name: STP Trader Group Value
Field.Description: Client defined trader group for self trade prevention

Field.Name: Time in Force Value
Field.Description: How long the order remains live

Field.Name: Trading at Closing price Value
Field.Description: Whether the order participates in trading at closing price

Field.Name: Order Condition Value
Field.Description: Condition changing the behaviour of the order

Field.Name: Cumulative Quantity Value
Field.Description: Previously executed quantity of the good till cancel order

Field.Name: Customer Order Capacity Value
Field.Description: Whether the order originates from a retail customer

Field.Name: Target Strategy Value
Field.Description: The target strategy of the PureStream order

Field.Name: Min Rate Value
Field.Description: PureStream minimum rate in the 1-500% range

Field.Name: Max Rate Value
Field.Description: PureStream maximum rate in the 1-500% range

Field.Name: Firm-Up ID Value
Field.Description: UserRefNum of the Ioi that received a firm up request
